copy.headline: No. 3 Texas clinches SEC Championship Game berth with 16-6 win over Texas A&M
copy.caption: No. 3 Texas leaned on its defense and three Gianni Spetic field goals to defeat rival Texas A&M 16-6, setting up a rematch with No. 1 Georgia in the SEC Championship Game.
